Guide

Troubleshooting by observable symptom

Find the earliest broken boundary and repair it; do not add a second owner as a workaround.

On this page
Editor/setup problemsNetwork/economy problemsSafe reporting

Editor/setup problems

SymptomInspect and fix
Native class absent in Blueprint parent pickerBuild/module/reflection errors and plugin dependencies; class must be Blueprintable when intended. Do not create an unrelated Blueprint with the same name.
Two player bodiesPlaced auto-possessed pawn plus GameMode spawn or duplicate admission callback. Remove duplicate creation path; one guarded spawn per lease.
No movementInput context/local-controller readiness, Axis2D values, possessed body and CMC enablement; no old X/Z plane constraint.
Feet float on slopeShared sprite foot pivot/root offset and capsule ground position; do not shrink collider to match a bad pivot.
Clothes driftSeparate clocks or incompatible page/frame/pivot. Sample one body phase, fix mapping or hide unsupported layer.
PaperZD API/node missingInstalled plugin version not matching assumed instructions. Read descriptor/source; retain blocked status rather than inventing a node.

Network/economy problems

SymptomInspect and fix
RPC never reaches serverCaller owns controller/Actor route? Local UMG cannot call server RPC on arbitrary resource actor it does not own.
Remote HUD stalePlayerState/ASC replication settings, actor-info readiness, attribute delegates and initial refresh; test both arrival orders.
Item duplicated after reconnectReceipt/source claim uniqueness, epoch fencing, status retry key, initial grant entitlement and OnRep side effects.
Currency deducted without itemSplit transaction bug; move inventory/wallet/stock/capacity into same durable commit, not compensating silently in UI.
Gate moves everyoneServerTravel used instead of selected controller ClientTravel.
Old zone can still saveRedemption did not atomically fence epoch or mutation endpoints do not validate it.
Fish granted after timeout twiceTerminal AttemptId receipt uniqueness or late notify/client completion used as reward authority.
Quest progress lostVerified event not persisted/deduped, UI-only counter, wrong cycle ID or stale snapshot revision.

Safe reporting

Record command ID, epoch/revision, build/catalog, expected/observed and redacted logs. Do not post bearer tokens, database connection strings or paid source sprites in public issues. Static doc checks do not diagnose a real gameplay race by themselves.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
